latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of JD Finance skill with comprehensive support for JD’s financial services:
- Provides information and management for JD’s investment products (定期/活期理财、基金、贵金属等)
- Supports full workflow for JD BaiTiao (白条) and JinTiao (金条) financial services, including loan and repayment queries
- Includes insurance product browsing, purchasing, and claims
- Supports JD credit card applications and management
- Enables consolidated asset and earnings queries, risk assessment, and investment advice
